name: setup_copper_and_dispatch_loop
description: Calls through a function table, writes the copper list high register and several globals, clears a large memory block and fills a 200-entry ramp table in steps of 40. It then loops until a status flag is clear and finally dispatches through a jump table.

name: dispatch_structure_callback
description: Calls a routine whose address is read from a fixed offset in a global structure, then returns the data register value unchanged.

name: add_to_field_and_refresh
description: Adds 6144 to a long field in the base-register structure and then calls one routine. Returns the two data register values unchanged.

name: set_global_value_two
description: Stores the constant 2 into one global variable and returns.

name: copy_field_and_step_position
description: Copies one word field to another, sets a field to 14, calls three routines and sets a word to 32. If a count field is nonzero, it advances an index that wraps at a limit, updates a position field and calls a routine.

name: set_field_and_step_position
description: Sets a word field to 8, calls three routines and sets a word to 32. If a count field is nonzero, it advances an index that wraps at a limit, updates a position field and calls a routine.

name: fill_bytes_below_limit
description: Writes a fixed byte value into consecutive memory from a start address for a counted number of bytes. If the start address is above a set limit, it skips writes past the upper bound instead.

name: clear_memory_block_longwords
description: Zeroes 27648 groups of four longwords starting at a fixed address, then returns the data register unchanged.

name: initialise_tables_and_dispatch
description: Sets two word fields to 32767 and a word to zero, clears a 5120-entry block and fills a 200-entry ramp in steps of 40. It sets a count to 20, waits while a status flag is set, and finishes by dispatching through a jump table.

name: dispatch_or_copy_word_list
description: If the first input word is negative, it waits for a status flag, copies a word list into a buffer up to a sentinel value and writes two chip register values. Otherwise it dispatches through a jump table and loops, polling a status flag and checking a four-character tag before it exits.

name: poll_and_dispatch_jump_table
description: Clears a field when a second field is zero, then waits until a count field reaches a threshold and a busy flag is clear. It sets the busy flag, updates a pointer and dispatches through a jump table.

name: decrement_counter_and_poll_dispatch
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter and clears a flag field when it reaches zero. It then runs the same wait-and-dispatch loop as its neighbour: waiting for a count threshold, polling a busy flag and dispatching through a jump table.

name: acquire_busy_flag
description: Waits until a busy byte is zero and then sets it to nonzero.

name: swap_buffer_pointer_pairs
description: Exchanges two pairs of longword pointers stored in the base-register structure, one pair at a time.

name: wait_until_word_nonzero
description: Clears a word field and then busy-waits until that field is changed to a nonzero value elsewhere.

name: build_copper_bitplane_list
description: Writes a copper list that starts with a display control word and the display window registers, then adds one bitplane pointer pair per scan line stepping by a fixed amount. It ends with a few colour and control register writes and a terminator.

name: repeat_call_power_of_two
description: Computes two raised to the power of a field value, then calls a routine that many times while counting down.

name: load_descriptor_into_fields
description: Reads a longword and a word from a source pointer and stores the word into two fields with a fixed flag bit set. It also copies a word, clears a field and stores a pointer offset derived from the longword. If a value in a global table is nonnegative, it calls three routines.

name: store_descriptor_fields_and_refresh
description: Stores a word from a source structure into two fields with a fixed flag bit set, copies two more words into fields and calls three routines.

name: set_mode_two_and_call
description: Sets a mode field to 2 and calls one routine.

name: set_mode_from_signed_word
description: Reads a word from a source pointer. If it is negative, it sets a mode field to 2; otherwise it copies the word into a counter field and sets the mode field to 4.

name: copy_word_into_field
description: Copies one word from a source pointer into a field in the base-register structure.

name: read_word_set_mode_six
description: Sets a mode field to 6 and returns the word read from the source pointer.

name: copy_three_words_into_fields
description: Copies three words from a source pointer into three fields and clears a fourth field.

name: dispatch_routine_from_table
description: Reads a word from a parameter structure, uses it as an index into a global table of routine addresses, and calls the routine it selects.

name: store_word_at_table_offset
description: Looks up an offset in a global table using a word value, then writes the second word of a source structure at that offset within the base-register structure.

name: load_table_values_into_fields
description: Reads an index and a pointer from its source structure, copies four words from lookup tables into fields, stores the pointer in a field and sets a mode field to 2.

name: wait_while_mode_active
description: Loops while a mode field is nonzero, writing an all-ones or zero byte into a flag field on each pass.

name: scale_packed_nibbles_clamped
description: Multiplies each of three 4-bit fields in a source word by a scale value, shifts the products down by four bits, clamps each to 15 and repacks them into a destination word.

name: copy_longwords_by_scaled_count
description: Works out a count from two fields by multiplying them and shifting, then copies that many longwords from one table to another.

name: advance_step_counter_and_call
description: Increments a step counter, adding an extra step when a flag and a mode are set. When the step passes a limit it decrements a repeat count and resets the counter, clearing a flag when the count reaches zero. It calls two routines on each pass and stores the returned value.

name: decode_packed_stream_stride_forty
description: Decodes a packed byte stream into a destination written every 40 bytes. Literal runs are copied, repeat runs fill with one byte, and special opcodes either skip columns or end the stream.

name: decode_rows_with_header
description: Reads a two-word header, stores derived size and offset fields, and copies up to 32 words into a buffer. It clears a block of longwords and then decodes a packed byte stream into rows written 40 bytes apart.

name: set_entry_pointer_and_flags
description: Stores a pointer computed from a global table into a structure, writes size and value fields from its inputs and ORs a bit into a control word.

name: set_slot_pointer_and_flags
description: Stores a pointer computed from a global table into a second structure, writes size and value fields and ORs a bit into a control word.

name: set_pair_pointer_and_flags
description: Stores a pointer computed from a global table into a pair structure, writes size and value fields and ORs a bit into a control word.

name: set_block_pointer_and_flags
description: Stores a pointer computed from a global table into a block structure, writes size and value fields and ORs a bit into a control word. It is the same pattern as its neighbours with different field offsets.

name: verify_checksum_or_reset_mode
description: Calls a routine to read a byte and compares it with a value built from two fields. If the check passes and two further routine results match, it calls a routine and returns; otherwise it sets a flag field and a mode field to 2.

name: xor_checksum_longwords
description: XORs a run of longwords from a source pointer into an accumulator, with the count taken from the input word, and returns the accumulator masked by a second register value.

name: combine_masked_longword_pair
description: Returns a combination of two longwords read from a source pointer, each masked by a register value, with the first word doubled.

name: initialise_entry_from_position
description: Computes two position values from an input word and a stored position, writes them into a structure with a fixed control word and a second word, and updates a stored position and a scaled size field.

name: copy_stored_word_to_entry
description: Copies a stored word from a base-structure field into a field of a second structure.

name: write_bytes_and_wait_ready
description: Writes one byte and two bytes taken from the input word to three byte registers, sets a bit in a fourth byte, and busy-waits until a status bit is set.

name: initialise_pointers_and_registers
description: Writes a fixed magic constant to a field, sets two buffer pointer fields and initialises several chip register values, including display window and colour registers. It sets a count to one, stores three routine addresses in a table and ends with two timing values.

name: decode_direction_bits_to_deltas
description: Decodes four bits of a control word into two signed step values, one for each axis, and stores them in two fields.

name: step_position_toward_targets_clamped
description: Moves two 16-bit position fields toward byte values from a source structure, handling byte wrap-around in the difference. It then clamps the results to the range 0 to 311 for the first and 0 to 98 for the second.

name: dispatch_on_input_bits
description: If an input bit is set, it either clears a flag and sets a mode field to 16 or sets the mode field to 64. When another bit is clear, it increments a counter and dispatches through a jump table.

name: set_mask_and_advance_sequence
description: Computes a one-bit mask from a counter field and stores it with an optional flag. It either writes two bytes and a complemented mask to a register or sets a mode field to 8, then calls three routines and advances an index through a table.

name: advance_sequence_if_status_clear
description: Checks a status byte and, when a bit is clear, adds 2 to a mode field. It then calls three routines and advances an index through a table.

name: advance_sequence_with_range_check
description: Skips ahead when a field is zero and a counter lies within a range of 6144 above a base. Otherwise, when a status bit is clear, it calls a routine and raises a mode field, then calls three routines and advances an index through a table.

name: step_mode_and_advance_sequence
description: When a status bit is clear, it calls a routine and raises a mode field by 2. It then calls three routines and advances an index through a table.

name: count_down_and_advance_position
description: When a status bit is clear, it counts down a repeat field. At zero it clears the mode field, otherwise it advances a position and sets the mode field to 8. It then calls three routines and advances an index through a table.

name: reset_mode_and_advance_sequence
description: Sets a flag field to 255 and the mode field to zero, calls three routines and advances an index through a table.

name: write_control_bytes_clear_bit
description: Clears bit one of a control byte, then writes two byte values and a zero to three byte registers at fixed offsets from the same base.

name: sample_bit_stream_and_store
description: When two input bits are set, it writes to a byte register and waits until a status bit matches before writing a zero byte. It then stores either a shifted bit value or zero in a result field and sets a mode field to 8.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until the value it leaves in a data register is zero.

name: double_longword_with_carry_bit
description: Doubles a longword field and adds one when bit one and bit twenty-three of the result differ, then stores it back.

name: select_slot_by_input_bit
description: Picks one of four slots from the set bits of an input word and sets a mode value for it. If the slot's flag is clear, it either counts down its counter or resets its pointer and clears its flag; otherwise it clears the flag.

name: write_mode_registers_and_refresh
description: When a mode field is nonzero, it writes two register values with a set high bit and clears the mode field. It then calls four routines.

name: accumulate_clamped_offset
description: Adds a stored word to a counter field. A negative sum resets three fields to zero, a sum below 256 is stored with a quarter of it in a second field, and anything larger is clamped to 256.

name: initialise_four_slot_structures
description: Sets four slot pointers into the base-register structure, each computed from a routine result plus a fixed offset, and stores slot size values. It then zeroes several fields.

name: clear_structure_fields
description: Zeroes two word fields and two byte fields in the input structure.

name: initialise_ramp_and_wait_loop

name: call_helpers_with_parameter_block

name: write_constant_table_of_values
description: Writes a long list of fixed numeric values into global variables, in groups separated by a marker value, and then returns 121.

name: call_helpers_with_index_offsets

name: loop_helper_calls_with_index

name: format_integer_as_decimal_text

name: call_helper_pair_with_arguments
description: Makes four helper calls, two of them with the same pair of parameter values, and returns the result of the final call. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: walk_text_string_with_helpers
description: Walks a zero-terminated text string from a fixed address. For each character it calls a text helper at a fixed position, then makes eight passes of paired helper calls, and returns the final helper result.

name: run_counter_loop_until_limit
description: Calls helpers repeatedly while a global flag stays zero, incrementing a counter and stopping once it passes fourteen. It then runs a countdown from forty with more helper calls. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: sort_paired_longword_table
description: Walks a table of four entries across five passes, swapping each pair of longwords with its partner whenever the first is smaller. Returns the final index. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: draw_five_row_value_table
description: Clears a field and draws five rows. For each row it draws a fixed-width value and a two-character value at fixed coordinate pairs, stepping down by sixteen units per row. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: call_helpers_on_nonzero_result

name: call_helpers_on_nonzero_result

name: scan_seven_entries_and_flag

name: call_seven_helpers_in_sequence

name: call_two_fixed_blocks
description: Makes two helper calls, each with a computed base index, a fixed 32 by 32 size and fixed argument values, then returns the result of the second call.

name: call_helpers_clear_four_slots
description: Makes two pairs of helper calls with fixed 32 by 32 sized arguments, then writes a shared value into four slots indexed by a computed index and returns that index.

name: call_two_table_block_draws
description: Makes two helper calls with fixed 32 by 32 sizes and fixed argument values, using two values read from a table indexed by a global index. It returns the result of the second call.

name: step_entry_timers_and_draw
description: Loops over ten entries. For each active entry it counts down a timer, advances a frame index on zero and wraps it at a limit, then calls a helper with fixed 32 by 32 arguments at the entry's position. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: draw_five_by_ten_grid
description: Loops over a five by ten grid. For each cell it fetches a table value and calls a helper with it, then calls a helper at the cell position, scaled by 32, with a fixed size. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: draw_grid_cells_by_row
description: Loops over grid cells in rows of ten and columns of five, calling a helper with a coordinate and fixed 32 by 32 sizes for each cell. It advances the row and column counters until the grid is finished.

name: scale_two_results_by_32
description: Calls helpers and stores two of their results, each multiplied by 32, into globals. It returns the high longword of a final helper result.

name: draw_stepped_strip_rows
description: Calls helpers with fixed sizes, then runs a loop from 162 down to 2 in steps of two, drawing 320 by 2 strips at successive positions on each pass. It finishes with more helper calls and returns the final result. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: convert_flag_store_offset
description: Converts a global value into a zero-or-one flag, then calls a helper and stores its result plus a fixed offset into a global. Returns the helper result. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: set_field_and_test_word
description: Sets a field to 22 and calls two helpers. It stores a flag that is one when a word equals 104, then returns that word. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: test_bit_in_table
description: Finds a byte in a table at a computed offset and returns one bit of it, chosen by a shift count taken from a register.

name: test_bit_in_table
description: Returns one bit from a byte in a table at a computed offset, selected by a shift count taken from a register.

name: allocate_and_init_record
description: Allocates a record through a helper and stores its pointer in an output parameter. On success it sets a table pointer and fields from the parameters; if setup fails it releases the record and returns the failure result.

name: init_record_fields_and_finish
description: Calls a helper to fill a record from its arguments, stores two argument values into the record and calls a finishing routine. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: set_table_entry_and_call
description: Looks up a pointer in a table by index and, if it is set, writes a fixed value and two parameter values into its fields before calling a helper. Returns the stored value. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: release_record_fields
description: Calls a helper on a record, then releases up to two nested pointer fields and the record itself through helper calls. Returns the last helper result. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: read_fixed_records_and_sum
description: Reads a four-byte value and a twenty-byte block through a sequence of helper calls, then returns the sum of two stored values. Returns zero when a read fails.

name: read_record_block_return_word
description: Reads a sequence of fixed-size blocks through helper calls, copies a block into the caller's buffer and returns a 16-bit value read from the record. Returns zero when a read fails.

name: read_bytes_until_flag_set
description: Repeatedly reads a counted run of single bytes through helper calls until a status bit is set or a read fails. It returns the status bits when they are set, otherwise one.

name: obtain_handle_from_table_entry
description: Looks up an entry in a table by index and calls a helper to obtain a handle, storing it. If the handle is valid it obtains a second handle and stores a 16-bit result from a further helper call. Returns the stored value, or zero.

name: open_handle_if_slot_empty
description: When a table entry is set and its handle slot is empty, calls a helper with the entry's values and the parameters, and stores the returned handle in that slot. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: release_handle_slot
description: If a handle slot is set, calls a helper to release the handle and clears the slot. Returns the byte offset of the slot. A shared prologue searches a table of routine pointers.

name: call_helper_for_indices
description: Calls one helper seven times, with the index values zero through six, and returns seven.

name: initialise_task_and_clean_up
description: Looks up the current task through the exec library, copies the argument bytes into a stack buffer ending with a space, and clears a block of 43 longwords of globals. It calls several library routines and optional cleanup routines, then returns.

name: release_resources_and_return
description: Runs an optional cleanup handler, calls library routines including a forbid step and a reply-message step, and conditionally releases the resources recorded earlier. It then returns the stored result.

name: invoke_two_function_pointers
description: Calls two library function pointers at fixed negative offsets from a base register, then returns.

name: open_dos_library_or_cleanup
description: Opens the dos library through an exec library call. If that succeeds it returns the handle, otherwise it runs the same cleanup sequence as its neighbours and returns 100.

name: find_or_allocate_list_node
description: Walks a linked list from a global head, stopping at a node whose field is zero. If none is free it allocates a 34-byte node and links it onto the list, then passes the node to a helper and returns that result.

name: parse_access_mode_and_open
description: Parses a two-character access string, where the first character selects read, write or append and the second selects a mode, then opens the target through a helper with matching flags. It stores the result and mode values in a structure and returns zero for unknown strings or failures.

name: read_stream_bytes_into_buffer
description: Fills a buffer with rows of bytes read from a stream structure, refilling the stream through a helper when its count runs out. It stops early when the helper reports the end of data and returns the number of completed rows.

name: open_slot_with_mode_flags
description: Finds a free slot in a table of handles, derives open flags from the input value and opens a handle through helpers. If the first attempt fails it retries with an alternate mode, then stores the handle in the slot and returns it, or minus one on failure.

name: call_helper_with_masked_flags
description: Calls a helper with a flag value built from bit fifteen of its second argument plus a fixed value, and with its third argument stripped of bit fifteen.

name: close_stream_and_flush
description: Flushes pending output when a flag is set, releases a buffer when one is present, then closes the handle through a helper. It returns zero on success and minus one when the flush or close fails.

name: flush_pending_stream_writes
description: Walks a linked list of streams, and for each stream that is open for writing with pending bytes it writes the pending bytes through a helper. It then calls a helper with its argument.

name: call_helper_with_field_eight
description: Calls one helper with the value of a field at a fixed offset from the base-register structure, then returns.

name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Returns the next byte from a buffered stream, refilling the buffer through a helper when it is empty. It sets an end-of-file flag on the value twenty-six and skips a carriage return by reading the following byte. Errors are recorded in status flags.

name: call_helper_or_set_error
description: Optionally calls a helper when a flag is set, clears the flag, then calls a helper and returns its result. If that result is zero it records an error code and returns minus one.

name: invoke_library_function_pointer
description: Calls one library function pointer stored at a fixed negative offset from a saved base value, then returns.

name: invoke_library_function_pointer
description: Calls one library function pointer at a fixed negative offset from a saved base value, then returns.

name: open_file_or_set_error
description: Calls a helper with a sentinel value and releases the result if it is nonzero. It then opens a file through a helper with a fixed mode value, returning the handle, or records an error code and returns minus one when the open fails.

name: invoke_library_function_pointer
description: Calls one library function pointer at a fixed negative offset from a saved base value, then returns.

name: invoke_library_function_pointer
description: Calls one library function pointer at a fixed negative offset from a saved base value, then returns.

name: open_file_or_set_error
description: Calls a helper with a sentinel value and releases the result if it is nonzero. It then opens a file through a helper with a fixed mode value, returning the handle, or records an error code and returns minus one when the open fails.

name: invoke_library_function_pointer
description: Calls one library function pointer at a fixed negative offset from a saved base value, then returns.

name: close_record_and_report_status
description: Looks up a record through a helper and returns minus one if it is missing. A record already marked as closed is cleared and returns zero. Otherwise it releases the record's handle and returns minus one when an error flag was set.

name: compare_c_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns minus one when the first is smaller, one when it is larger and zero when they are equal.

name: release_all_entries_then_call
description: Walks a table of entries and, for each one that is set and not marked, calls a helper with its stored value. It then calls a helper with its own two arguments.

name: write_stream_byte_newline_mode
description: Writes one byte to a buffered stream. When the text-mode flag is set it expands a newline into a carriage return and a newline, and it flushes the buffer through helpers when full. It returns the byte written, or minus one on error.

name: call_helper_after_lookup_check
description: Looks up an entry through a helper and returns minus one if it is missing. Otherwise it calls a helper with three arguments and returns its result, or minus one when an error flag is set.

name: call_helper_then_return_zero
description: Optionally calls a helper when a flag is set, calls a helper with its argument, then returns zero.

name: invoke_library_function_pointer
description: Calls one library function pointer at a fixed negative offset from a saved base value, then returns.

name: calculate_string_length
description: Walks a null-terminated string to find its end and returns the number of characters before the terminator.

name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Writes a byte value into a run of memory for a given count and returns the start address.

name: allocate_buffer_if_missing
description: Returns zero when a buffer is already present and not marked for reset. Otherwise it allocates a buffer through a helper, stores its pointer and size, clears the position fields and records error code twelve when allocation fails.

name: seek_then_call_helper
description: Looks up a stream through a helper and returns minus one if it is missing. If the stream has a flag set it seeks to the start, then calls a helper with the remaining arguments and returns its result, or minus one when an error flag is set.

name: call_helper_record_failure
description: Calls a helper with three arguments after clearing an error flag. If the result is minus one it records error code five and returns the result.
